svg.aria-label: Rename: the machine behind its exits
svg.text: Rename: the machine behind its exits
Drawn from the Passages room. A micro-op comes in and takes one exit: a wait, or a step on to the next room. Each exit is a state, and each pair of states has one arc.
while no integer register is free
while no FP register is free
while the rename queue is full
while the reorder window is full
while the branch slots are full
Solid arcs rest on measurements or two sources.
Dashed arcs rest on one source or are derived or inferred.
○ stall no reg: No free register
○ stall no FP reg: No free FP register
~ stall rename queue: Rename retire queue full
○ stall branches: Too many branches in flight
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
